sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.

1. Heard Smt. Shikha Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri Rajesh Kumar Sachan,
learned State Law Officer appearing for the State respondents.

2. The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 31.12.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 359 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 304B, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Ghiror, District Mainpuri.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioner in the aforesaid case.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned AGA opposed the prayer for quashing of the FIR, which discloses cognizable offence.
4. Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
